_about: Fixes for mistakes in the 5etools data. Key: "Name|SOURCE". Value: _mod edits (same modes as _copy). Applied by the resolver before anything else; a patch that stops fitting is reported.

Strike of the Giants|BGG._why: The save DC and uses rules sit inside the Storm Strike block, so every other giant option loses them. Move them out so they belong to the whole feat.

items.name: Storm Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

items: The saving throw DC for these effects equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Constitution modifier.
You can use this feat a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
